kitLazy.mismatch: The {label} view does not match the plugin version. Reconnect, then open it again.
kitLazy.invalidPart: The view arrived incomplete. Try again.
kitLazy.updated: The view was updated meanwhile. Try again or reconnect.
kitLazy.versionMismatch: The view does not match this version. Reconnect to load it.

kitSend.unavailable: This agent is no longer available
kitSend.outOfBandNote: Paseo runs this command on its own: the current turn and pending approvals are not affected
kitSend.maybeOutOfBandNote: This command may run on its own, or it may interrupt the current turn
kitSend.maybeOutOfBandConfirm: With goals turned on, Codex runs /goal beside the current turn without interrupting it or touching approvals. Without goals, sending this {what} interrupts its current turn. Send anyway?
kitSend.maybeOutOfBandConfirmApproval: With goals turned on, Codex runs /goal beside the current turn without interrupting it or touching approvals. Without goals, sending this {what} interrupts its current turn and cancels the pending approval request. Send anyway?
kitSend.waitingNote: The agent is waiting for your approval; sending cancels it
kitSend.waitingSteerConfirm: The agent is waiting for your approval. This {what} will join the current turn and the approval request will be canceled, so the action waiting for approval will not run. Send anyway?
kitSend.waitingConfirm: The agent is waiting for your approval. Sending this {what} interrupts the current turn and cancels the approval request, so the action waiting for approval will not run. Send anyway?
kitSend.steerNote: Running; joins the current turn without interrupting it
kitSend.slashBlockedNote: Running; this command cannot join the current turn
kitSend.slashBlockedConfirm: This agent is running. This command cannot join the current turn, so sending the {what} interrupts it. Send anyway?
kitSend.noSteerNote: Running; this agent cannot take messages mid-turn
kitSend.noSteerConfirm: This agent is running and cannot take messages mid-turn, so sending the {what} interrupts its current turn. Send anyway?
kitSend.closedNote: The session is not loaded; sending loads it
kitSend.maybeDelivered: The last send may have gone through. Open the session and check before sending again.
kitSend.changed: The agent's state changed. Confirm this message again before sending it.

kitDeferred.afterApprovalNote: Leaves the approval alone and sends automatically once you have handled it and this turn ends
kitDeferred.afterTurnNote: Does not interrupt; sends automatically when the current turn ends

kitDeferredServer.queued: Queued. Sends automatically when the agent finishes this turn and has no pending approvals.
kitDeferredServer.scheduled: Scheduled. Once its time comes, sends automatically when the agent finishes its turn and has no pending approvals.
kitDeferredServer.movedOn: New messages arrived in the session after this was queued. Still send it?
kitDeferredServer.unsure: The session changed after this was queued, and it is unclear whether someone else sent a message. Still send it?
kitDeferredServer.unknown: No result came back, so it may have been delivered. "Send anyway" checks the session first and resends only if the message is not there. You can also cancel.
kitDeferredServer.failed: Sending failed: {error}. "Send anyway" checks the session first and resends only if the message is not there. You can also cancel.
kitDeferredServer.failedRepeatedly: Sending failed several times: {error}. "Send anyway" checks the session first and resends only if the message is not there. You can also cancel.
kitDeferredServer.stopped: The plugin reloaded before this was sent. "Send anyway" sends it when the agent is idle. You can also cancel.
kitDeferredServer.settling: The last send may still be in progress; the message is not in the session yet. Try "Send anyway" again in two minutes.
kitDeferredServer.unreadable: Could not read the session, so it is unclear whether the last send arrived. Try "Send anyway" again later.
kitDeferredServer.cannotTell: The session is too long to check whether the last send arrived. Open the session: if the message is not there, cancel this one and send it again.
kitDeferredServer.strangers: The session has messages of unknown origin (possibly rebuilt from history), so it is unclear whether the last send arrived. Open the session: if the message is not there, cancel this one and send it again.
kitDeferredServer.late: Could not confirm the agent's state in time, so nothing was sent. Try again.
kitDeferredServer.foundSame: The session already has a message with the same text, so it was not sent again (the session does not record message ids, so it cannot tell whether that was this one)
kitDeferredServer.maybeSent: Unclear whether it was delivered. Open the session to check.
kitDeferredServer.canceledUnknown: Canceled and not resent; the earlier attempt may have been delivered
kitDeferredServer.discarded: The agent is archived or gone; not sent
kitDeferredServer.expired: Queued for more than a day; gave up sending
kitDeferredServer.expiredScheduled: Could not be sent within a day of its scheduled time; gave up sending
kitDeferredServer.busy: Another message is being sent to this agent, so this one was not sent. Try again shortly.
kitDeferredServer.gone: This agent is archived or gone; nothing was sent.
kitDeferredServer.refusedAfterTry: {reason}. It was sent once before and delivery was not confirmed, so it will not be sent again. Open the session to check.
kitDeferredServer.guardUnknown: Could not confirm this message still applies ({error}); not sent.
kitDeferredServer.guardUnknownBusy: Could not confirm this message still applies ({error}); not sent. Try again shortly.
kitDeferredServer.guardHeld: Could not confirm this message still applies ({error}); not sent. "Send anyway" checks again. You can also cancel.
kitDeferredServer.lockBusy: Could not get the send lock (the lock file is not usable), so nothing was sent. Try again shortly.
kitDeferredServer.lockHeld: Could not get the send lock (the lock file is not usable), so nothing was sent. Retry or cancel.
kitDeferredServer.lockUnusable: The lock file is not usable
kitDeferredServer.noStart: The agent did not start the turn within {seconds} seconds
kitDeferredServer.otherRun: The agent is running another turn
kitDeferredServer.finishingTurn: The agent is still finishing its last turn
kitDeferredServer.timeout: Paseo did not answer in time
kitDeferredServer.notConnected: The plugin is not connected to the Paseo daemon yet. Try again shortly.
kitDeferredServer.tooLong: The message is too long to send.
kitDeferredServer.tooLongToQueue: The message is too long to queue.
kitDeferredServer.tooFarAhead: A message can be scheduled at most 7 days ahead.
kitDeferredServer.badSchedule: The scheduled time is not valid.
kitDeferredServer.goneCannotQueue: This agent is archived or gone, so the message cannot be queued.
kitDeferredServer.tooLateToCancel: This message is already being sent; it is too late to cancel.
kitDeferredServer.readAgentTimeout: Reading the agent timed out. Try again shortly.
kitDeferredServer.noGuardCheck: The plugin has no check for this condition
kitDeferredServer.tooManyQueued: Too many messages are queued. Clear some first.
kitDeferredServer.tooManyForAgent: Too many messages are queued for this agent. Clear some first.
kitDeferredServer.movedOnScheduled: This scheduled message is due, but new messages arrived in the session after it was queued. Still send it?
kitDeferredServer.unsureScheduled: This scheduled message is due, but the session changed after it was queued, and it is unclear whether someone else sent a message. Still send it?

kitLanguage.title: Language
kitLanguage.label: Display language
kitLanguage.hint: The text in this plugin. Follow system uses the device's language, or English when that language is not available.
kitLanguage.folderHint: Put a translation in {folder}, named by its language code, such as ko.json. Copy templates/en.json or templates/zh-CN.json and translate it; entries you leave out show in English.
kitLanguage.issueNotObject: The file is not a JSON object.
kitLanguage.issueNotSection: "{id}" is not a group of messages.
kitLanguage.issueUnknownMessage: "{id}" is not a message of this plugin (ignored).
kitLanguage.issueBadShape: "{id}" must be text or plural forms with "other".
kitLanguage.issueTooLong: "{id}" is too long or contains control characters.
kitLanguage.issueBadPlaceholder: "{id}" uses {detail}, which this message does not have.
kitLanguage.issueLink: The file is a link; put the file itself here.
kitLanguage.issueTooBig: The file is larger than 2 MB.
